verses.text: The one who smashes everything is coming against you. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourself! Gather all your strength!
The LORD is restoring Jacob’s greatness, like Israel’s greatness, even though destroyers stripped them and ruined their vine branches.
The shields of his warriors are red; the soldiers wear scarlet. On the day he prepares for battle, the chariots flash with metal, and pine spears are brandished.
The chariots race through the streets and rush back and forth in the open spaces. They look like flaming torches and dart like lightning.
He summons his elite troops, but they stumble as they advance. They rush to the city wall, and the protective shield is set in place.
The river gates open, and the palace collapses.
It is decided: the queen is stripped and carried away. Her attendants moan like doves and beat their chests.
From long ago, Nineveh was like a pool full of water, but now its people are fleeing. “Stop! Stop!” someone shouts, but no one turns back.
“Take the silver! Take the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, every kind of precious object in abundance.
The city is empty, ruined, and wrecked. Hearts melt; knees shake. Everyone’s strength drains away, and faces turn pale.
Where is the lions’ den now, the place where young lions were fed? The lion, lioness, and cubs once walked there without fear.
The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled prey for his lionesses. He filled his caves with kills and his dens with prey.

“Look, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies. “I will burn your chariots in smoke. The sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and no one will hear your messengers’ voices again.”
